Bhaginī.l: Bhaginī ca bhātaro satta, nibbattā sottiye kule
Bhaginī.g: Upakañcanādayo cha ahañcāti bhātaro satta sabbakaniṭṭhā Kañcanadevī nāma bhaginī cāti sabbe mayaṁ aṭṭha janā mantajjhenaniratatāya sottiye uditodite mahati brāhmaṇakule tadā nibbattā jātāti attho.
